(A) 4pm to 6pm
(B) 6pm to 8pm
(C) 8pm to 9pm
(D) 3pm to 4pm

- **10pm to 11pm** - This is the time when Hannah was not at the park.

Since Hannah was at the garden from 6pm to 8pm, and at the rooftop from 8pm to 9pm, the only time she could have been at the park is between 6pm and 8pm.

Answer: (B) 6pm to 8pm
